findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hard-coded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived IAM credentials to anyone with read access to the function configuration or Terraform state, and risking leakage via logs or version control.

The Lambda function does not configure a KMS key for environment variable encryption (relying on default encryption only) and uses the deprecated nodejs12.x runtime, which is past end-of-life and no longer receives security patches.
